title: TikTok User Search Scraper
description: Search public TikTok profiles by keyword and collect handles, display names, follower counts, and verification status. Batch topics to find creators in a niche or map public profiles.

batch.title: Keywords
batch.description: Keywords, account fragments, or creator niches to search.
batch.valueDescription: keywords used to run this search.

schema.description: Search text for public TikTok users. Use a username fragment, brand name, creator niche, product category, or campaign keyword.
Number of user matches to return for the page, up to 50.
Pagination cursor from the previous response. Pass this value with the same `keywords` query when `hasMore` is true.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search public TikTok users by keyword for names, handles, followers, and verification status. Discover creators and map audience niches for research.
storeCopy.intro: Search public TikTok accounts by keyword and collect profile identifiers, display names, avatar URLs, follower counts, and verification state. Cursor pagination bounds collection.
useCases: Creator partnership teams can find public profiles that match a topic or niche.
Social analysts can compare follower counts and verification across searches.
Brand teams can build lists of relevant public accounts before planning outreach.
howToUse: Add one keyword or creator niche to `keywords` per search.
Set `count` per page and use `maxPages` and `maxResults` to bound collection.
Read flattened profile fields alongside nested source objects.

faqs.question: Does the search include private accounts?
faqs.answer: No. The Actor searches public user results and does not provide private account data.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Public TikTok profile identity, including account ID, handle, display name, and avatar.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: Public profile measures, including follower count and verified-account status.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: TikTok account identifier returned for this public profile.

fields.name: unique_id
fields.description: Public TikTok handle shown on the profile.

fields.name: nickname
fields.description: Display name shown on the TikTok profile.

fields.name: avatar
fields.description: Public profile image URL returned for the account.

fields.name: follower_count
fields.description: Number of followers reported for the public account.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: True when TikTok marks the public account as verified.

fields.name: input_keywords
fields.description: Keyword submitted to find matching public TikTok profiles.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this profile record was collected.
